description:
You can commit to code, but can you commit to the answer under pressure? We put attendees on the spot at GitHub Universe 2026 to test their knowledge of Git commands, repositories, and internal storage objects. From repository forks to git blame and blob objects, see how well developers know the tools they use every single day. Did you get all three trivia questions right, or did that final question catch you off guard?

Did you know the GitHub Universe 2026 conference badge has hidden capacitive gaming buttons on the back? In this quick demo, Martin Woodward shows how to install Super Mona directly onto your badge using the GitHub Copilot app. Just copy the repo instructions, paste them into Copilot chat, and let the agent configure the app. Flip your badge around and enjoy retro gaming straight from your conference lanyard. Add it to your own badge: https://github.com/martinwoodward/super-mona
